mapper.insert: insert into course_selection(student_id, course_id, select_time) values(#{studentId}, #{courseId}, #{selectTime})
mapper.select: select cs.*, s.student_name, c.course_name from course_selection cs left join student s on cs.student_id = s.student_id left join course c on cs.course_id = c.course_id where cs.course_id = #{courseId}
